newsitem.title: UK: Community Hospitals sells homes to BUPA.
newsitem.headline: Community Hospitals sells homes to BUPA.

text.p: LONDON, MAY 29 (REUTER) - British health care company Community Hospitals Group Plc said on Thursday that it had agreed to sell 14 of its 16 nursing homes to the private health provider BUPA for a total consideration of 34 million stg.
Community Hospitals said BUPA would pay 28.6 million stg ($46.8 million) in cash, and acquire debts of 5.4 million stg.
The company said the disposal would result in a gain of four million stg based on net asset values.
Chairman Alan Dexter said the sale "creates the opportunity for us to pursue the development of our more profitable hospitals business, where we are confident that the prospects are excellent".
